title: Very weak and small
text:
Very weak and small. First off, these are cute. Very very small. Slightly bigger than the head of a pencil eraser. I had expected them to be bigger when I ordered them but that is on me for not checking it more carefully. The magnet doesn’t hold very much weight wise so we just use these for tiny notes on our fridge. My daughter did discover you can stack them on top of each other and they magnetize like that so that was fun.

They are cute if you want them for decor but not super functional. 3/5 stars.
